This feels good — pasting the address and getting back the title, the site name, the description, and a spot for the image all together as a card is exactly the kind of thing I hoped for. It saved with basically no effort, which is the whole point. And having that one prominent box at the top to drop a link into feels right to me.

Two small things I want to make sure work as we go. The image area here is just a placeholder — I'd want a real preview picture of the page when there is one, since that's a big part of recognizing a link at a glance. And I mentioned before that I'll sometimes want to fix the title or description if the automatic one is off — I don't see a way to do that yet, so I'd like to check that later. But for what you're showing me right now, the automatic save is just what I expected.
